parsed.name: 电化学恒电位/恒电流仪
parsed.description: 基于 SCPI 控制的电化学恒电位/恒电流仪，用于输出或测量电压、电流与开路电位，并执行极化、斜坡、阶梯、充放电以及 PITT/GITT 等电化学实验。
parsed.description_en: A SCPI-controlled electrochemical potentiostat/galvanostat used to source or measure voltage, current, and open-circuit potential, and to run polarization, ramp, staircase, charge/discharge, and PITT/GITT electrochemical experiments.
